BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Rear Delts
SECONDARY
Rhomboids, Traps, Rotator Cuff

Instructions

Preparation: Set a rope at or slightly above face height and grip the ends with palms down. Step back for tension, arms extended straight toward the pulley.

1

Extend arms toward pulley, palms down.

2

Stay steady; set your shoulder blades.

3

Pull toward face, separating grips past ears.

4

Keep elbows high and knuckles up.

5

Return slowly with your elbows high.

6

Straighten arms; keep cable tension.

Watch out

Pulling low turns it into a row. Set the cable at face height, pull towards your eyes with elbows high, and finish with knuckles facing the ceiling.
